messages.subject: Meetings this quarter: 10-12 Fri, Wickson 2124
parts:
Hi all,

Our meetings this quarter will be held 10-12 on Fridays, in Wickson 2124. This Friday, Apr 3, we'll have a quick introduction for new members and then a regular open work session.

Our first talk of the quarter will be next week (Apr 10).  Jaime Ashander will present on visualizing the outputs of generalized linear models (GLMs).

We have had requests for talks on R packages for: boosted regression trees, structural equation modeling, and RStan/MCMCglmm.  If anyone is interested in giving a short introduction to these topics (or others!), please let me know.

- Noam
